events.name: Bash
events.head: Check commit, push, migration and deploy state
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git log --oneline -3 -- cloud/migrations/0027_attendee_devices.sql app/src/app/admin/admin-client.tsx; git branch -r --contains $(git log -1 --format=%h -- cloud/migrations/0027_attendee_devices.sql) | head -2; grep -ci "device" app/src/app/admin/admin-client.tsx; grep -n -i "workers.dev/admin" app/src/app/admin/admin-client.tsx | head -3; cd cloud && npx wrangler d1 migrations list revops-centre --remote 2>&1 | tail -4; npx wrangler deployments list 2>&1 | grep -E "Version|Created" | tail -2
